headline: The computer mouse gets its patent
post_facts: A wooden shell with two wheels

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen seventy... a wooden box with two wheels got a patent.

scenes.label: Douglas Engelbart
scenes.caption: Inventor at SRI, 1968
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Douglas Engelbart called it an X-Y position indicator.

scenes.label: The first mouse
scenes.caption: Prototype, Computer History Museum
scenes.text: [softly] His team just called it the mouse... because of its tail.

scenes.label: about what Apple paid to license it
scenes.text: [calmly] His institute licensed it to Apple for about forty thousand dollars. Engelbart got no royalties.

scenes.title: Every click started here
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Every click goes back to that box.

scenes.title: Do you still use a mouse?
scenes.text: [gently] Do you still use a mouse?
